name: aedos
description: Local web application that allows students to automatically generate academic presentations in PDF using the Google Gemini API.

scripts.test: node --test tests/frontend-preview-transition.test.js tests/pptx-export-text.test.js tests/pptx-export-layers.test.js tests/pptx-export-styles.test.js tests/pptx-export-shadows.test.js tests/pptx-export-appearance.test.js tests/pptx-export-advanced.test.js
scripts.test:safe: node --test --test-isolation=none tests/frontend-preview-transition.test.js tests/pptx-export-text.test.js tests/pptx-export-layers.test.js tests/pptx-export-styles.test.js tests/pptx-export-shadows.test.js tests/pptx-export-appearance.test.js tests/pptx-export-advanced.test.js
scripts.test:contract: node --test --test-isolation=none --test-force-exit tests/contracts/backend-contract.test.js tests/contracts/errors.test.js tests/contracts/sse.test.js tests/contracts/request-normalizers.test.js tests/contracts/router-order.test.js tests/contracts/provider-seam.test.js
scripts.verify:baseline: npm run test:safe && npm run test:contract && npm run test:pressure && npm run test:sanitization && npm run test:stub-guard && npm run check:dom && npm run check:baseline:visual && npm run verify:pptx:baseline && npm run baseline:export && npm run check:baseline:export && npm run check:baseline:pdf
scripts.verify:quality: npm run lint:ratchet && npm run typecheck:ratchet && npm run format:check
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:baseline && npm run verify:quality
